Relays checkout POST /checkout-sessions/\{sessionId\}/confirmations with the PSP token (never a card number: card-shaped fields and a token that is a card number are refused with 422 before any upstream call). Uses the long confirm budget. 200 carries a definitive session, 202 an in-doubt placement to poll.
